segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on your account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Daniel at Northstar Controls. Email is daniel.ross@northstarcontrols.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’ve got Northstar Controls pulled up in the admin console. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We need to add six seats for the operations team before Monday. We’re at 42 today, and I want to take it to 48. Same plan, no other changes.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure. I’m checking the billing tool now. Your renewal is September 30, so these would be prorated from today through then. The added amount is $318.42 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that’s fine. Will it hit the card on file, or do we get an invoice?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re set to invoice billing with net 30 terms. I can add the six seats now and the invoice will generate within about 10 minutes. It’ll go to ap@northstarcontrols.com.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Can you also make sure I’m still the admin who can assign them?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep, I see you and Priya Shah as account admins. You’ll be able to assign the new seats as soon as I save the change.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: All set. Your seat count is now 48. I also created ticket 184732 as a record of the change, and you’ll get the invoice shortly.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I see the seats in the admin console now. That’s all I needed, thanks.
